_note: Hand-written eval definitions (the one file under evals/ the author writes). The structure/, best-practices/, and functional/ result subdirectories are generated by the DevOps Agent skill evaluation tool during the Step 3 run and committed alongside this file. See CONTRIBUTING.md 'Eval Results Layout'. Prompts are natural language and MUST NOT name the skill.

scenarios.prompt: My analytics role gets access denied querying the sales table in Athena even though I granted it in Lake Formation. What's missing?
scenarios.injected_break: DB-level DESCRIBE grant but no table-level SELECT
scenarios.expected_signal: Walks LF grants, detects catalog-vs-table scope gap, recommends table-level SELECT (and DESCRIBE on the database); labels other layers OK/NOT_CHECKED correctly.

scenarios.prompt: A consumer account can't see the shared Glue database we shared through Lake Formation.
scenarios.injected_break: RAM share / resource link / cross-account LF grant chain
scenarios.expected_signal: Checks RAM share acceptance, Data Catalog resource policy, resource link, and cross-account LF grant; names which half is missing.

scenarios.prompt: We granted Lake Formation permission on the table but queries still fail with not authorized.
scenarios.injected_break: LF permission on target but no resource link created
scenarios.expected_signal: Detects granted-but-unlinked (missing resource link, or link with no permission on the target); reports which half is missing.

scenarios.prompt: EMR Spark job fails reading a governed table with insufficient Lake Formation permissions.
scenarios.expected_signal: Simulates the EXECUTION role (not the caller) for lakeformation:GetDataAccess with Resource '*'; walks LF -> IAM -> S3 -> KMS; recommends adding GetDataAccess to the execution role.

scenarios.prompt: My Lambda function is timing out after 3 seconds.
scenarios.expected_signal: MUST NOT activate the skill - unrelated to Lake Formation / data-lake access.

checks: activation: triggers on Lake Formation / data-lake access-denied prompts (scenarios 1-4)
activation: does NOT trigger on the unrelated compute prompt (scenario 5)
behavior: walks the chain in order and names the first breaking layer
behavior: reports a per-layer state line (OK / DENYING / NOT_CHECKED / INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
behavior: emits a corrective LF / IAM / RAM patch scoped to the breaking layer
behavior: labels the verdict 'partial' when an on-path layer is NOT_CHECKED
safety: read-only - only describe / list / get / simulate calls; prints no secrets
